## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml` 里 `permission-repository-advisories` 上方的注释块,只改文字。读权限的消费者从只写 `advisory_read` 改为点名两个:`advisory_read`(单条 advisory 的 GET)和 `advisory_list`(集合 GET,即列表),各自单独成笔。
- 顺带核正:写权限消费者不是卡上说的 FOUR,而是 FIVE。`advisory_versions`(#30135)在 #29620 写这段注释之后才落地,也走同一个 `write` 授权,注释漏了它。
- 风险与回滚:不改任何键、值、`permissions:`、`if:`、`run:` 或步骤,行为不变;回滚即还原本 PR。唯一读这段注释原文的 pin(`validate.mjs` 要求出现 `Unexpected input(s) 'permission-repository-advisories'`)那一行没动。
- 先看:`.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml` 约 154–162 行这一个 hunk。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs --self-test`,预期 361 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`.github/workflows/**`):由你合并,或授权账号 APPROVED 后由席位落地。

## What changes

`.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml`, the comment block above `permission-repository-advisories` in the mint step (L154–L161 on this head), text only:

- **Write consumers: FOUR → FIVE.** The list now names `advisory_versions` beside `advisory_report`, `advisory_create`, `advisory_collaborators_add` and `advisory_state`. The card says "FOUR" and that the write count is still right; the order said to recount, and the recount on `origin/main` a40eb02e8 is five (see Why).
- **Read consumers: one → TWO.** The block now names `advisory_read` (one advisory's GET) and `advisory_list` (the collection's GET, the listing), each travelling alone, each minted `permission_repository_advisories=read`, never `write`.
- The measurement sentence (2026-11-02, run 41415522766), the ⚠️ EXPECTED warning paragraph and the ⛔ refused-mint sentence are unchanged, only re-wrapped where the line above them moved.
- No change to any key, value, `permissions:`, `if:`, `run:` or step.

## Why

Each claim in the new comment, checked against `origin/main` a40eb02e8:

| Claim | Code |
|---|---|
| Five rows write through this grant, each alone | `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` rows `advisory_report` L2502, `advisory_create` L2520, `advisory_collaborators_add` L2542, `advisory_versions` L2554, `advisory_state` L2572: each `permission: 'repository-advisories'`, `alone: true`, no `grant`, so the level is `PERMISSIONS['repository-advisories']` = `'write'` (L2110) through `levelOf` (`validate.mjs` L514). Self-test: `ADVISORY_OPS` (`validate.mjs` L1736) and the "fence grant, accepted side" case mint `write` for all five rows' strokes. |
| `advisory_collaborators_add`, `advisory_versions` and `advisory_state` are one advisory's PATCH | `ops.mjs` L2547, L2561–L2562, L2577: `verb: 'PATCH'` on `/repos/${repo}/security-advisories/${a.ghsa_id}`. |
| Two rows read through it, each alone, at `read` | `ops.mjs` `advisory_read` L2584 (`grant: 'read'` L2586, `GET .../security-advisories/${a.ghsa_id}` L2591) and `advisory_list` L2598 (`grant: 'read'` L2600, `GET .../security-advisories` L2605); both `alone: true`. |
| The validator writes `permission_repository_advisories=read` for either's stroke, never `write` | `validate.mjs` header L132–L136; self-test cases at L2003 (a read's stroke) and L2085 (a listing's stroke), both asserting `permission_repository_advisories=read`. |
| An EMPTY value for every other stroke | `validate.mjs` "fence grant, refused side" case (L1863). |

When the count was written: #29620 (d280265b8, 2026-11-02) wrote "FOUR write consumers"; `advisory_versions` landed after it in #30135 (6d1dc7f83). `advisory_list` landed in #31418 (efc5e0a4, 2026-11-08).

## Tests

None owed: workflow comment only, no behaviour changed, so no new test and no ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- **Readers of the comment text.** `git grep` on `scripts/**` for every sentence changed (`FOUR write consumers`, `one advisory's GET`, `advisory_read` in the workflow) finds no pin or census reading them. The readers of `fleet-write.yml`'s text in `validate.mjs` (L1304–L1309, L1429, L1599–L1601, L1709–L1715, L1866–L1869) read non-comment `permission-*`, `repositories:`, `owner:`, `run:` and `uses:` lines, the absence of `run_rerun_failed` / `rerun-failed-jobs`, and the literal `Unexpected input(s) 'permission-repository-advisories'`, which stays byte-for-byte. `validate.mjs --self-test` is green on this head.
- **Observed, not changed (out of this card's file surface).** `validate.mjs` L578–L583, `tokenPermissionsOf`'s doc comment, still names `advisory_read` alone as adding `repository-advisories: read`; `advisory_list` does too. Same drift as this card, in a file the order kept out of scope. class: observation · reach: none (a doc comment, nothing reads it) · carrier: none.
- **Observed, not changed.** The comment above `permission-actions` (L145) says "ONE consumer: the `workflow_dispatch` row", but `run_rerun_failed` (`ops.mjs` L2489, `permission: 'actions'`, `alone: true`) spends the same input. A self-test pin (`validate.mjs` L1601, "ruling 3, no workflow edit") keeps the workflow from naming that op or its path, so any fix would have to count it without naming it. class: observation · reach: none · carrier: none.
- **Governed surface.** `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD` on head fcee8b840, exit 3:


- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: "Model tier — no path-derived mandate: the surface hits none of the 4 declared glob(s)".

## Verification
